result.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 COPD，用自然语言交流代替教师 logits 做 on-policy 蒸馏：学生自主决定何时向黑盒教师提问并自由组织请求，把成功的学生—教师交互留作特权参考，用于与任务奖励 RL 联合训练无顾问的学生轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 agent 工作，不含视觉 latent，但「自主决定何时咨询教师」可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 式证据获取与停止决策，特权参考监督也可能对应轨迹贡献分配与教师信号筛选问题。
